prebakes.name: node-smol/base
consumers: node-smol builder (+ COPY --from=ghcr.io/socketdev/socket-wheelhouse/node-base for the .mts driver)
prebakes.purpose: The heavy Node.js/V8 compile environment, on top of the wheelhouse c-base. Split into its own layer for CACHE LOCALITY: the toolchain rarely changes, the Node source changes every version bump. The .mts driver's node comes via COPY --from=node-base, not a baked runtime.

fuzz.reason: No first-party parser/decoder surface to fuzz yet: repo is fleet tooling plus vendored upstream/ native trees (stuie, decmpfs) that carry their own test tiers upstream. Revisit when node-smol grows first-party parsing code.
